versions.content: If data is transmitted using an IPv6 UDP socket which is bound to a local address (TcpIpAddrId) of type Multicast, the TcpIp - shall select the source IP address of the IPv6 header according to the source address selection algorithm sp ecified in section 5 of IETF RFC 6724 (Default Address Selection for IPv6). The selection shall be limited to the configured local addresses (TcpIpAddrId) on the same EthIfCtrl as the bound local address (TcpIpAddrId) only.
